title: 第一卷 第7章 秘境历练第一卷 第8章 赠送法器
slug: 百倍返还我家孽徒全是女帝转世
content_zh:
一夜转瞬即逝。
次日天刚蒙蒙亮，柳雨姝早已收拾好简单行囊，安安静静站在洞府外等候。
她身着统一的宗门弟子服饰，虽然简单却干净利落，小小的身影挺拔笔直，已经有了一丝未来女帝的气势。
一旁的林枫依旧是一身白衣，即便发丝凌乱，依旧仙风道骨，气质春尘。
师徒二人并肩下山，走出小竹峰山门，到达青云宫中央。
这时，一道带着几分讥讽的苍老声音忽然传来。
“哟，这不是林枫峰主吗，今日怎么下山了？”
只见闲散长老赵谦负手而立，目光上下打量着林枫，满脸轻视。
此人向来趋炎附势，十年前林枫修为鼎盛时，他百般巴结。
林枫修为尽废后，他便落井下石，恨不得把脚踩在林枫头上。
赵谦的目光又落到一旁身形单薄的柳雨姝身上，嗤笑一声：“啧啧，真是稀奇，林峰主如今连个像样的弟子都收不到，竟然收了个小乞丐来充数？”
周围路过的外门弟子见此处有热闹，也是都往这边看过来，眼神里带着打量和戏谑。
“赵长老又在挖苦人了。”
“没办法，谁让林峰主现在就是个废人。”
“连徒弟都这般不起眼，小竹峰真是彻底没落了。”
听着四周的议论，柳雨姝小脸一白，下意识往前半步，想要挡在林枫身前。
她心里又愧又急，只觉得是自己这营养不良的模样，害得师父被人嘲讽。
一双宽厚的大手却挡在她身前。
林枫面色平静无波，抬眸看向赵谦，语气慵懒却又带着几分锋芒。
“赵长老若是闲来无事，不如去闭关修行。与其整日盯着我小竹峰说长道短，倒不如想想，如何突破卡了七年的金丹境巅峰。”

赵谦脸色瞬间沉了下来，怒声呵斥：“林枫！你如今修为被废，沦为废人，也敢对我出言不逊？”
“废人？”
林枫轻笑一声，眼神变得锋利：“当年我巅峰之时，你不过是个堪堪摸到金丹期巅峰的小辈。”
“管好你的嘴，再敢对我师徒二人不敬，休怪我不顾同门情分。”
短短几句话，气场逼人。赵谦被怼得脸色青一阵白一阵，又气又恼。
他没想到已经成为废人的林峰竟会有胆量和他较劲！
他心里清楚，真要是当众动手，反倒会落个戕害同门的罪名。
可当着众多弟子的面，他不愿落了颜面，硬撑着冷哼：“狂妄自大！既然你要带这丫头去秘境历练，我倒要好好看看，废人教出来的徒弟，能有什么本事！可别活着进去，躺着出来！”
“不劳长老费心。”
林枫懒得再与他纠缠，抬手一挥：“雨姝，走。”
说罢，不再理会脸色铁青的赵谦，带着柳雨姝转身离去，径直走向宗门秘境的入口。
青云宫的万兽秘境，是专供适宜内门弟子历练之地，此处遍布中低阶妖兽，灵气浓郁，最适合低阶修士锻炼实战、冲击境界。
俩人刚踏入秘境，此起彼伏的兽吼便从四面八方传来，空气中处处透着凶险。
“从今日起，正式开始历练。”
林枫负手而立，声音沉稳：“你负责正面应对妖兽，积累实战经验。我会在一旁守着，指点你出招，也会确保你不受到致命伤害。”
“斩杀妖兽后，妖丹归你。若遇见千年灵木、玄铁、兽骨这类炼器材料，便收好，为师日后为你量身打造本命法器！”
“弟子明白，多谢师父！”
content_en:
The night flies by.
At dawn the next day, Liu Yushu had already packed her simple luggage and stood quietly outside the cave, waiting.
She was dressed in the uniform uniform of a sect disciple, which was simple but clean. Her small figure was tall and straight, and she already had a hint of the aura of a future empress.
Lin Feng on the side was still dressed in white, and even though his hair was messy, he still had an immortal air and a pure temperament.
The master and apprentice walked down the mountain side by side, walked out of the Xiaozhu Peak Gate, and arrived at the center of Qingyun Palace.
At this time, an old voice with a hint of sarcasm suddenly came.
"Hey, isn't this Peak Master Lin Feng? Why did you come down the mountain today?"
I saw the idle elder Zhao Qian standing with his hands behind his back, looking at Lin Feng up and down with contempt on his face.
This person has always been a fan of others. When Lin Feng was at his peak ten years ago, he fawned over him in every possible way.
After Lin Feng's cultivation was exhausted, he added insult to injury and wanted to step on Lin Feng's head.
Zhao Qian's eyes fell on the thin Liu Yushu beside him, and he sneered: "Tsk, tsk, it's really strange. Master Lin can't even recruit a decent disciple now, so he actually accepted a little beggar to make up for it?"
When the outer disciples passing by saw the excitement here, they all looked over here, with appraising and joking expressions in their eyes.
"Elder Zhao is being sarcastic again."
"There is nothing I can do. Master Lin is now a useless person."
"Even the apprentice is so inconspicuous, Xiaozhufeng is really in complete decline."
Listening to the discussions around her, Liu Yushu's face turned pale and she subconsciously took a half step forward to block Lin Feng.
She felt ashamed and anxious, feeling that it was her malnourished appearance that caused Master to be ridiculed.
A pair of big, generous hands stood in front of her.
Lin Feng's face was calm and calm, he raised his eyes and looked at Zhao Qian, his tone was lazy but with a bit of edge.
"If Elder Zhao has nothing to do, why not go into seclusion and practice. Instead of staring at my Xiaozhu Peak all day long and gossiping, why not think about how to break through the peak of the Golden Core Realm that has been stuck for seven years."
Zhao Qian's face instantly darkened, and he yelled angrily: "Lin Feng! Now that your cultivation has been abolished and you have become a useless person, how dare you speak rudely to me?"
"A useless person?"
Lin Feng chuckled lightly and his eyes became sharp: "When I was at my peak, you were just a junior who could reach the peak of the Golden Core Stage."
"Watch your mouth. If you dare to be disrespectful to my master and disciple again, don't blame me for ignoring our friendship."
In just a few words, the aura is compelling. Zhao Qian's face turned blue and white at times, angry and annoyed.
He didn't expect that Lin Feng, who had become a useless person, would have the courage to compete with him!
He knew in his heart that if he really did it in public, he would be charged with murdering his fellow disciples.
But in front of many disciples, he didn't want to lose face and snorted coldly: "Arrogant! Since you want to take this girl to the secret realm for training, I want to take a good look at what the disciples taught by useless people can do! Don't go in alive and come out lying down!"
"Don't bother the elders."
Lin Feng was too lazy to argue with him anymore and raised his hand: "Yushu, let's go."
After that, he ignored the livid Zhao Qian, turned around and left with Liu Yushu, heading straight towards the entrance of the sect's secret realm.
The Secret Realm of Ten Thousand Beasts in Qingyun Palace is a place specially designed for inner sect disciples to practice. It is full of mid- to low-level monsters and has rich aura, making it the most suitable place for low-level monks to practice actual combat and challenge their realm.
As soon as the two stepped into the secret realm, beast roars came one after another from all directions, and there was danger everywhere in the air.
"From today on, the training officially begins."
Lin Feng stood with his hands behind his back and said in a calm voice: "You are responsible for dealing with the monsters head-on and accumulating practical combat experience. I will stand by and guide you in your moves, and I will also ensure that you do not suffer fatal injuries."
"After killing the monster, the demon elixir will be yours. If you come across thousand-year-old spiritual wood, black iron, animal bones and other weapon-refining materials, keep them so that my master can tailor-make your natal magic weapon in the future!"
"Disciple understands, thank you Master!"
